message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.lean_wil: The wolf in you is too wild to run light. It wants the whole beast.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.111: A werewolf who has mastered the change and kept the curse tame can sneak as they change (U) to become a lean wolf on all fours: quicker and higher-leaping than the great beast, but no stronger.
